I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time weather data. However, I can give you a quick overview of San Francisco’s typical climate:

| Season | Typical Temperature | Weather Notes |
|--------|---------------------|---------------|
| Winter (Dec–Feb) | 48–58 °F (9–14 °C) | Cool, often foggy, especially near the coast. |
| Spring (Mar–May) | 55–68 °F (13–20 °C) | Mild, gradually warming; occasional rain. |
| Summer (Jun–Aug) | 57–75 °F (14–24 °C) | Warm, dry, but coastal fog can keep temperatures cooler. |
| Fall (Sep–Nov) | 58–70 °F (14–21 °C) | Pleasant, decreasing rainfall. |

If you’d like a current forecast or more detailed information, you could check a reliable weather website or app (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or the National Weather Service). Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!
